scope: Partial edition with source passages in all eight chapters. English for passages 2:8, 2:11, 3:10 and 4:4 is partial or from a differing edition, and commentary links for them are not established. Other source-empty or unmatched passages remain omitted; chapter 4:12 has an untranslated biblical quotation. Commentary links are passage-level, not sentence-level.
attribution: Shir HaShirim Rabbah, Hebrew Wikisource contributors; individual page revisions and contributor histories are listed in source-manifest.json. CC BY-SA 4.0.
changes: Removed navigation and styling from 11 pinned Wikisource pages; preserved paragraph and list text in source order. Matched English and existing commentary references by numbered source coordinates after comparing editions. No OCR or new translation performed by Amudi. Added eight pinned Wikisource pages in the second passage and paired English/commentary by source coordinates. Added 17 pinned pages from passages 1:3 and 1:9–13 with corresponding English and checked commentary references. Added nine whole Wikisource passages and reordered chapter 1; English and commentary references for those passages are grouped at passage level. Removed Wikisource edit-control labels accidentally retained in nine whole passages. Added 14 selected chapter 2 passages from pinned Wikisource pages; passages 8, 10 and 11 are omitted. Grouped English and commentary references are passage-level. Added selected chapter 3 passages from pinned Wikisource pages. Grouped English and commentary references are passage-level. Added selected chapter 4 passages from pinned Wikisource pages; English and commentary references are passage-level. Added selected chapter 5 passages from pinned Wikisource pages; English and commentary references are passage-level. Added selected chapter 6 passages from pinned Wikisource pages; English and commentary references are passage-level. Added selected chapter 7 passages from pinned Wikisource pages; English and commentary references are passage-level. Added selected chapter 8 passages from pinned Wikisource pages; English and commentary references are passage-level. Added four source-only Wikisource passages; left English and commentary links blank where alignment is not checked and preserved prior source-position links. Added explicitly labelled partial English from the CC BY 3.0 Sefaria 2022 edition for four source variants. No commentary mappings were inferred.
